CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION finance_private.accountant()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT public.account_enabled() AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_members s JOIN public.profiles u ON u.id=s.user_id WHERE s.user_id=auth.uid() AND u.banned_at IS NULL AND s.active AND 'finance'=ANY(s.perms)) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_command_status(p_request uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 select result from finance_private.commands where request=p_request and actor=auth.uid() and finance_private.accountant()
$function$
